audience: 7–9 歲・小二至小三自主閱讀
title: 雨天的竹筒樂隊
theme: 雨天不能出門，祖孫從互相搶快到停下傾聽，合奏自己的音樂。

characters.duoduo: 朵朵，八歲女孩；寬方臉、棕色皮膚、雀斑、小杏眼、單個高束黑捲髮；青綠寬T恤、赭紅七分闊褲、米白帆布鞋，身形結實。
characters.grandpa: 公公，七十歲；瘦高、長方臉、禿頂白側髮、白短鬚、長鼻、長方金屬眼鏡；米白短袖、深綠背心、炭灰長褲、棕鞋。公公是稱謂，不另作姓名。

presentation.coverAlt: 朵朵與公公一起準備竹筒、竹筷和竹笛
dedication: 在雨天也會找樂子的小朋友。

learning.heading: 聽見竹字頭
learning.subtitle: 跟着祖孫的音樂，認識六個竹部字。
explanation: 竹作部首時，常寫在字的上方，叫竹字頭。
筷、筒、笛都是竹部字；等、笑也屬竹部，卻不是竹製物品。
learning.example: 等一等，聽清楚，再接上節拍。
learning.note: 部首幫助我們查字，並非每字都指竹器。
learning.question: 找一找：竹、笑、哭，哪個不是竹部？

lines: 朵朵提着竹籃，望着門外。
spreads.beat: 想出門卻遇雨，建立等待的欲望。
spreads.art: Girl lower LEFT standing holding an EMPTY oval bamboo basket, shoulders slumped, looking toward the open doorway at far left edge where thin grey rain is visible. Grandfather lower RIGHT on a low stool, attentive. No instruments yet. Warm sheltered veranda, tiny floor strokes, no snow.

lines: 公公把一個竹筒放進籃裏。
朵朵找來一雙竹筷，輕輕敲了敲。
spreads.art: Grandfather crouches lower RIGHT with relaxed hands after offering one bamboo tube. Girl lower LEFT kneels by basket and taps the smooth side of ONE upright closed-bottom bamboo tube using TWO short blunt bamboo chopsticks, one in each hand. Tube stands stably on a woven mat outside basket; basket nearby, single tube only, no flute yet. Show complete bodies and intact hands.

lines: 公公用手輕輕打着節拍。
spreads.beat: 快不等於合奏，邀請主角重新嘗試。
spreads.art: Girl lower LEFT eagerly tapping her one bamboo tube with two chopsticks. Grandfather lower RIGHT seated on low stool, one hand gently tapping his thigh to keep a slow beat, raised calm eyebrow, not scolding. Rain strokes only at far left doorway. Basket beside girl. Complete figures, no flute yet.

spreads.beat: 用停頓讓讀者也聽見雨。
spreads.art: Girl lower LEFT pauses mid-performance, TWO chopsticks held still above tube, head turned toward rain at far left, alert little smile. Grandfather lower RIGHT quietly listens with hands resting on knees. Three tiny rain rings outside doorway, visual rhythm, no notation or letters. Basket and single tube remain.

lines: 公公拿出竹笛，吹起一段短短的曲子。
朵朵一聽見熟悉的旋律，就笑了。
spreads.beat: 加入第二種音色，笑由情節引出。
spreads.art: Grandfather lower RIGHT seated and playing ONE genuine sideways transverse bamboo flute: horizontal across mouth, correct hand placement and visible small finger holes, never a recorder pointed down. Girl lower LEFT smiles broadly, slightly uneven front tooth visible, two chopsticks resting above tube. Same empty basket beside her, no musical glyphs.

lines: 竹筷越敲越急，笛聲被蓋住了。
spreads.beat: 再次失衡，人物須自己選擇如何合作。
spreads.art: Girl lower LEFT enthusiastically hurries tapping single tube, two distinct chopsticks and a few small pencil motion ticks. Grandfather lower RIGHT stops blowing and lowers the transverse flute across lap, gently bemused. Both intact, not angry. Only these two people, same instruments and basket.

lines: 她等笛聲停下，才輕輕接上。
spreads.beat: 從搶快改成等待、傾聽與接續。
spreads.art: A calm turn-taking moment: grandfather lower RIGHT finishes playing a short phrase on horizontal transverse flute; girl lower LEFT waits with two chopsticks lifted but motionless, attentive narrow eyes, her single tube in front. Basket beside mat. No sound writing or extra hands.

lines: 窗外的雨，成了第三個隊員。
spreads.beat: 圖文以擬人表達聽雨，不把雨畫成人。
spreads.art: Joyful ensemble lower half: grandfather seated RIGHT plays horizontal bamboo flute; girl seated LEFT taps bamboo tube gently with her pair of chopsticks. Small rain strokes outside far left doorway. Natural individual smiles, slight leaning body rhythm; rain remains ordinary rain, not a person, creature or musical symbol. Full figures.

spreads.beat: 天氣改變，為原來的出門願望製造選擇。
spreads.art: Girl lower LEFT stands at open doorway pointing at a few remaining droplets falling from eave, no rainfall. Grandfather lower RIGHT carefully puts ONE transverse bamboo flute into oval basket; single bamboo tube remains on mat by basket, pair chopsticks laid together on mat. Faces and hands whole, all shoes visible, no cropped limbs.

spreads.beat: 反轉收束：不必等雨停才快樂，主角主動再合奏。
spreads.art: Girl lower LEFT gleefully lifts her pair of chopsticks ready over the single tube. Grandfather lower RIGHT laughs, holding transverse flute again, ready to play, not yet at lips. Basket beside girl, sky outside doorway now pale and clear. Affectionate but not saccharine, full bodies, one tube one flute two chopsticks. No text.
